headline: Visa To Rally Around 23%? Here Are 10 Top Analyst Forecasts For Wednesday
summary: JP Morgan raised the price target for Visa from $400 to $450 and Mizuho increased PayPal's target from $50 to $60. Other analysts also raised targets for Xylem, RLI, ITW, DLR, STX, and PCAR.

headline: Cantor Fitzgerald Maintains Overweight on Digital Realty Trust, Raises Price Target to $221
